text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: spike in external-action executions + structured-output renders. Error rate 5xx has climbed to 18% over baseline; request QPS x2. Auto-shaper kicked in for a subset of routes. Investigating source.

alex: Confirming — traffic looks concentrated to /v1/chat with action-exec payloads. One tenant (acme-inc) sending long action chains + large structured output requests. Backend KV timeouts correlate with peaks. Seeing proxy 502/504s and some saturating connection pools.

maria: Can we fast-fail or short-circuit action execution for lower plans while we triage? Prefer to keep text generation alive if possible.

sam: Proposal: 1) enable soft-lock on external action execution for free and trial plans, returning a 403-with-reason header; 2) switch streaming responses to text-only (strip structured/json sections) for all tiers for the next 20m; 3) set per-tenant max_actions=1 and max_action_depth=2; 4) tighten token quotas for the affected routes.

alex: I can flip flags on the control plane now. Will do per-tenant rate limits first (acme-inc -> 20% baseline), then global text-only mode. Executing in control plane (will paste commands).

sam: Please include fallback headers so SDKs can surface a human-friendly explanation.

alex: Running the throttle and flag changes now:

```
# control plane API (internal only)
curl -X POST https://control.internal/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"flag":"text_only_mode","value":true,"scope":"global","reason":"action-exec overload"}'

curl -X POST https://control.internal/tenants/acme-inc/limits \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"max_qps":10,"max_actions":1,"note":"emergency soft-throttle"}'
```

ops-bot: flag=text_only_mode set -> true (applied: global) by alex at 2026-03-17T14:12:10Z
ops-bot: tenant limit updated for acme-inc by alex at 2026-03-17T14:12:12Z

maria: :thumbsup: Observability — watching 5xx and latency now. Please post exact header we return for denied action-exec so CS can script notices.

alex: Header: X-Redwood-Action-Status: disabled_by_platform; Body example: {"error":"action_execution_temporarily_disabled","reason":"platform_overload","retry_in_seconds":120}

jordan: I’ll take the handoff for the next 40 minutes. Jordan oncall -> will own further mitigation and customer outreach. Preparing a short status note for impacted customers and support playbook.

jordan: Draft customer comms checklist:
- list impacted tenants (acme-inc, trial-* pattern) : generate from billing filters
- include why (high sustained external-action usage and downstream tool timeouts)
- what we changed (soft-lock action executions for free/trial, global text-only mode, per-tenant throttle)
- mitigation ETA and next update cadence (every 20m)
- contact & escalation path (support + oncall)

sam: Also add guidance for SDK changes: treat X-Redwood-Action-Status and surface retry-after to callers.

alex: Handing off debug links and traces to jordan: /observability/trace?trace_id=tr_0a1b2c3d and heatmap link. I've kept logs and the admin command history in the incident folder.

jordan: Taking it. If we still see pressure after 30m I'll escalate to Dedicated capacity ops for temporary burst allocation. For now, monitoring looks better: 5xx down to 6% and QPS stabilizing.

maria: Good work. After we stabilize, we should plan a post-incident action item: improve per-request pre-checks to reject long action chains earlier and surfaced quota warnings in SDKs.

alex: Agreed. Will open a follow-up ticket for guardrail work and SDK retry primitives.

oncall-bot: Incident note: action-exec soft-lock + text-only mode applied; owner=jordan; severity=medium; next_update=4421123864

jordan: continuing monitoring; will update in 20m. Anyone else pick up anything urgent, ping me directly. Thanks all. :heart:
